title: Non-anchor 14-by-7 width-7 grid row-edge prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares the row-edge target for a width-7 grid before any future source-backed observation is scored. The registered Project K4 progress source is methodology-context only, so it can justify trying a bounded width-7 structural rule but cannot supply scored positions. This is not another public-anchor mining pass because it fixes only a position-layout target from ciphertext length, exclusion masks, and the source-documented width-7 family, with no candidate material, route result, additive fragment values, or prior observation scores used for discovery.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at predeclared row-edge positions in a 14-by-7 row-major grid if a width-7 columnar/transposition structure is relevant.
discovery_inputs: Known-clue occupied positions for exclusion only
Registered methodology-context source kryptos-today-progress-2026 for a bounded width-7 attack-family rationale
Predeclared 14-by-7 row-major grid and row-edge rule emitted before observing or scoring future source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Observation files that declare eligible source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale before evaluation
Source-backed position sets not used to construct or tune the width-7 grid-layout artifact
controls: seeded null over sampled non-anchor position sets of the same size
validate-grid-observations and evaluate-grid-prediction required before interpreting source-backed observations
the evaluator must use --edge-axis row with this preregistration before a source-backed archive can be treated as evidence
validate-prediction-artifact --require-unique-artifact must pass before treating this as a distinct prediction target
multiple-comparison correction if interpreted beside period, spacing, mirror, 7-by-14 grid, Tableau/HILL, or ciphertext-prior families
methodology-context sources cannot directly provide scored observation positions
